L0_contract_finding.question: What does Preprocessing officially output? What does V3 consume?
L0_contract_finding.conclusion_on_input_transport: For the spring chemistry paper, the MD text Phase 1 consumes is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the official Ocr-markdown output. Input transport did NOT mutate the text.
L0_contract_finding.who_adds_structure: Preprocessing produces MD (OCR lines/text/images/formulas). Structural declarations (unit_id, stem_lines, options[].label, answer_lines) come from a SEPARATE annotation/manifest layer (reslice_pipeline + LLM manifests) in Papers/scripts + *.manifest.json. V3 preprocessing_consumer reads manifest + md and maps them into annotation payload.

NOT Architecture A (preprocessing does not emit full Question/Option/Answer objects).
L0_contract_finding.official_vs_experiment: Official curated MD lives under Ocr-markdown/{会考,合格考,学业水平考试,...}. reslice-batch-C / reslice-pac / auto-annotated-* are EXPERIMENTAL reslice/annotation variants used by Phase 1. Phase 1 has NOT completed raw-PDF→preprocessing→V3 formal E2E via the TaskExecutor production path (per PREPROCESSING-V3-LOCAL-INDEPENDENT-VERIFICATION).
